name: Olga Diamandis
abstract_title:
The Last Corporate Generation: AI, Collective Consciousness, and the Collapse of Industrial Work

A mother–son generational clash revealing the uncomfortable truth: AI, Gen Z, and rising global awaren
abstract: For millennia, human work has reflected the dominant structure of collective consciousness: tribal cooperation, guild identity, industrial hierarchies, and finally the global corporation. For decades, we believed corporations were permanent — the final model for human coordination. They are not. They are an era. That era is ending. Artificial intelligence is rapidly becoming part of the cognitive infrastructure of work — influencing shared memory, organizational attention, and group reasoning. F
notable: Co-author on AI adoption; previous roles at Disney, Mattel, Mars, Nestlé, P&G
